scripts.i18n:pot: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/od-webgl-effects wp i18n make-pot . languages/od-webgl-effects.pot --domain=od-webgl-effects --exclude=vendor,node_modules,dist,build,tests,docs
scripts.i18n:mo: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/od-webgl-effects wp i18n make-mo languages
scripts.i18n:json: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/od-webgl-effects wp i18n make-json languages --no-purge --use-map=i18n-map.json
